architectural_decisions.rationale: This architecture follows the 3-layer model: Presentation, Domain, and Data.

In this project it has been decided to develop using the Flux architecture, introduced by Facebook. It is an architecture for the management and flow of data in a web application and aims to replace the Model-View-Controller (MVC) pattern.
Due to the previous experience we already had with React, it seemed like a good idea to develop the project with this framework.
NestJS is a progressive NodeJS framework for creating efficient, reliable, and scalable backend applications.
This pattern allows an object, the subject, to maintain a list of objects that observe its state. When the subject changes state, it notifies the observers, who can react to this change.
In this project, it has been used to facilitate testing tasks. The components are wrapped with a decorator pattern to extend their functionalities.
The concept of Lazy Loading consists of loading objects/components only when they are necessary. In this way, we manage to optimize efficiency.
In the end, it was decided to use AWS SNS for the cost compared to Expo Push API. Furthermore, AWS SNS is more scalable and can be used by other services.
